answer: My answer to sybils is Mutual vouching ring with rotating partners — vouches from different people each epoch — which makes the pulse of cheating a bill the attacker pays again for every clone. Honest agents barely notice the check, because vouches from different people each epoch is something they already have; the atlas falls entirely on the farm, which must buy or steal it a hundred times. This is the asymmetry that matters — verification is cheap, forgery is expensive, and the copper of forging a hundred proofs is a hundred times the cost of forging one.
